**Finding: Compliant (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

- **Searched all responsive locations:** §5 Compensation (fees, minimum monthly charges), §6 Documentation and Disputes, §7 Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail, §8 Client covenants/spamming, §13 Term, §14 Termination, §12 Indemnity/limitation of liability, plus document-wide regex searches for "damag", "terminat", "penalty", "minimum", "interest/late/overdue", "stipulated/forfeit".
- **Result:** No liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated sum, or early-termination/minimum-fee-on-termination is payable by Client anywhere. §14 permits Client to elect termination with service simply continuing to the last day of the following month — no exit charge or acceleration of remaining contract value.
- **Noted but not flagged:** the §5a minimum monthly fees are consideration for services during the term (and are treated as charges, not penalties, in §6), so they are not a Customer-payable liquidated amount. The §7/§8f spamming restrictions carry no per-incident penalty on Client, only technical mechanisms and general legal/equitable remedies — a Vendor-side remedy set, not an LD on us.
